name: Twins Lust
source:
Twins Lust is a short story about the lives of two sisters, June and April Adams and their husbands, John and Nero, who are also twins.

What events await people whose days are devoted to lust and their own desires?

In this series of short games you can find out and see all this with your own eyes.

[From [url=https://stateofmindproduction.itch.io/twins-lust-part-1-completed/]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《双胞胎欲望》讲述了两姐妹琼·亚当斯和阿普丽尔·亚当斯以及她们的双胞胎丈夫约翰和尼禄的生活的短篇故事。

那些整天沉迷于情欲和自己欲望的人将会面临什么事件呢？

在这一系列的小游戏中你可以亲眼发现并看到这一切。

[来自[url=https://stateofmindproduction.itch.io/twins-lust-part-1-completed/]Itch.io[/url]]
